info.name: Un-Dogeify Twitter [Obsolete]
info.description: This CSS is obsolete. If you want to forget about Musk's 'X' website and make it look like Twitter again, then try the following: Twitter Bird Is Back (UserCSS) Control Panel for Twitter (UserScript) Original description follows: Just when you thought Elon Musk was making enough stupid decisions already, now he wants everyone to know he's being sued by Doge shareholders. Well, let's fix that. This style replaces the dog with the Twitter logo again. PS. My Twitter is @BoffinBrain if you like geeky stuff.
